children: Guardian Pharmacy Services said it acquired assets from Nautilus Pharmacy, a Tennessee-based company providing mail-order pharmaceutical services.

Guardian said it acquired prescription files, related pharmacy inventory, and certain fixed assets. Guardian also said it will begin to provide pharmacy services for former Nautilus community partners via 18 company pharmacies in their local communities.
Guardian plans to retain more than half of Nautilus Pharmacy's employees, including pharmacists and pharmacy technicians, to allow continuity for community partners and residents.
Nautilus offers services to assisted living facilities across 14 states, operating out of a centralized, mail-order pharmacy location.

David Brown, senior vice president of the Central Region at Guardian Pharmacy Services, said the transition to Guardian pharmacies already operating in their markets will bring the services closer to customers, and will provide local accountability, responsiveness, and senior care expertise.
